Rookie lifeguard Max impresses his peers when he pulls off the fabled "Hellman" rescue of two patients. A Korean student's dream surfing trip to Australia comes to a painful end. An unusual visitor to Bondi Beach surprises rookie lifeguard Alex. Beachgoers report car keys stolen off the beach.

Tragedy unfolds as a Chinese backpacker is left comatose after-hours. A father loses his son in a massive crowd. Lifeguards struggle communicating with the distressed Cambodian man. Former ironman Kailan Collins shares the details of his rare injury for the first time in seventeen years.

Beachgoers report a drunk woman missing in the water, and the chopper is called in to search. On Australia Day, Whippet enlists honorary lifeguard Jon, a 16 year-old boy with Asperger's Syndrome. And the most critical rescue of the season stirs up emotional memories for Terry.

Lifeguard 'Harries' plans to propose to girlfriend Emily high above Bondi in a chopper, and needs the team to make a huge 'Marry Me' sign in the sand. But in the lead up Kerrbox throws a spanner in the works, putting blue paint in Harries' spray tan.

The biggest mass rescue at Bondi in years sees over 40 swimmers in trouble, the beach closed and lifeguards stretched to their limits. Former pro surfer Nicola Atherton is the 4th ever female lifeguard to join the team. She finds herself on the frontline of a mass rescue.

Lifeguards investigate an unidentified floating object a kilometre offshore. Harries loses his cool with a tourist. Mario rescues a woman clinging to an inflatable tomato. Deano introduces a new training technique - submersion in an ice bath.

Beloved Bondi lifeguard Maxi risks his life to rescue two fishermen from an overturned boat in challenging seas. Jethro is angry after rescuing tourists he had warned about rips, then later collapses on the beach. Luke Daniels rides a wave using the oldest surfboard design in the world.
The Bondi community is rocked when a brawl takes place at the North End. A lifeguard race adds to the action. Harries and Tommy are involved in rescues... but can Tommy successfully back up Harries?

Tommy practices on the jetski but no one has told him about the perils of seaweed. Even the experienced Glick is caught off guard when the jetski does something unexpected. Chase and Will use the jetski to race around to the north of Bondi after a man is reported to have fallen off the cliff.

On New Year's Eve, lifeguards Harries and Kerrbox contend with drunk swimmers. Backpackers steal the lifeguard buggy. A shark sighting leads to the evacuation of a crowd of 40,010 people from the water. Chaos ensues when a woman reports her baby abducted by another woman.

Christmas time and North Bondi becomes the North Pole as reindeers join Santa for a beach visit. Though it's not all happy holidays for a young local boy who suffers a serious accident in the skate bowl. And the festive spirit turns deadly with a nasty combination of alcohol and surf.

When a backpacker has a violent seizure for over 15 minutes, team leader Beardy fears long-term consequences. In the water, Sam attempts a daring move during a dangerous rescue, while fellow rookie Luke swallows his pride after an embarrassing blunder.

Backpackers trade snowflakes for sunscreen as they flock to Bondi for Christmas. The Hare Krishnas make an appearance, both on land and in the rips. Maxi plays a Christmas prank on his cousin Ryan, and Nicola receives news of a scuba diver drowning off Bondi's northern headland, Ben Buckler.

Snoop Dogg visits Bondi on New Years. Lifeguards arrive at 5am, rescuing partygoers from rips. One girl loses consciousness, but lifeguard suspect she is a serial offender intentionally endangering herself. The emergency chopper is called for a missing swimmer last seen in the water two hours ago.
Kite surfers make the most of the wild conditions when the biggest storm of the season hits Bondi. Chappo and Jack race to help a man with agonising chest pains, and Harries confronts a body surfer.

All of the designers reunite one last time to discuss their experiences on Project Runway together, settle any last feuds that still exist in the group, and reminisce about their time on this season. Tim Gunn hosts.

In this season's casting special, "Road to the Runway," sixteen new designers will be introduced with a behind-the-scenes look from their casting auditions, home visits, casting submissions, and sit-down interviews. Tim Gunn will present the designers in carefully carved out categories that will lead you into the season premiere.

In the season premiere, sixteen new designers meet Tim and Heidi at Madison Square Garden, where they scramble across the seats to gather fabric for their first challenge. In the workroom, they reveal their strengths and weaknesses as they create looks to show who they are as designers.

The designers are dealt a big surprise in the first Unconventional Materials Challenge of the season! Each designer must create a wearable look using greeting cards as their main textile. Ashley Tisdale joins the judges.

In the first Team Challenge of the season, the designers are paired up and treated to a day on a Celebrity Cruise ship. For some of the duos, the friendly seas are left behind and they hit some rocky water in the workroom. Tracee Ellis Ross guest judges.
The designers finally get to go to Mood and they are thrilled! They must put a modern and unique twist on a classic design. Mad Men's Kiernan Shipka joins as a guest judge.

Tensions arise when the designers split into two teams and battle for their fabrics in a fierce paintball competition. After capturing their fabrics for a six-piece collection, the teams receive a big surprise once the paint dries on the battlefield! Kelly Osbourne and Lisa Perry guest judge.

In an episode full of surprises, Heidi challenges the designers to create lingerie for her line. The exhausted designers get a rude awakening on the runway. Actress Bella Thorne serves as a guest judge.

"Will you answer me?" Without having a chance to clear up Yeongsin's misunderstanding, Jeonghu continues investigating what happened to his father. Boss' special team is on Jeonghu's tail to cover up the truth he uncovers. Yeongsin visits Myeonghui to find her truth as well, and ends up seeing Jeonghu there. Those under Munho come together and their operation begins...

"Like ordinary people" The truth of what happened that fateful day is finally exposed, thanks to the tape of Junseok's testimony. Jeonghu decides to stay by Yeongsin's side, and live like ordinary people. The first step of living an average life is meeting his girlfriend's father. However, Munho continues his attack on Boss, who was also exposed along with the truth about Junseok, and Someday falls under attack.

"I'll protect you" Boss uses the same tactic he used on Munsik to own Jeonghu, but Jeonghu bets on himself and leaves Yeongsin to face off against him. Munho and Someday News do not give in to his threats and continue to report on Boss' identity. However, Minja, who has been helping Jeonghu, ends up being tracked by Munsik's cyber team...

"Goodbye, Healer" Boss uses Yeongsin's and Munho's weaknesses to continue threatening them, and Jeonghu feels his limitations in fighting him alone. Minja gathers everyone together, and Munho and Yeongsin prepare a retaliation interview. The day before the big day, Jeonghu prepares a gift for Yeongsin and makes a final decision for the welfare of everyone else.

Dong Joo insists that the sole reason why he's at the hospital as an intern is that he wants to save lives. In Soo wants him to keep his relationship with his fellow doctors first before he busts any move on the operating table. Seo Jung sees a lot in the new intern. For now, they attend to a couple of patients from a construction site accident.

Seo Jung finds out that she could only use her dominant arm up to its 70% capacity after the untoward accident that happens to her. Her life as a surgeon changes forever after a familiar face breaks the news to her. Dong Joo meets In Bum, who seems like a threat to his career at the Geosan University Medical Center. He's the president's son, and he's got a sneaky attitude.

Seoyeong is determined to maintain her lie about going overseas. There is no way she can confess to Ujae that she lied about her father. Sangu is distraught at her decision but can't help her out. There is no way that he can disown his father no matter how much he has hated him too. In the midst of this Hojeong agrees to go to the U.S. with the promise that after she returns she can do whatever she wants. In the end Samjae goes to be a pretend guest at a VIP's wedding... The twist is shocking!

It's been 3 years since the last episode... Jiseon has a hard time adjusting to her perfect daughter-in-law... What every other mother-in-law would be happy about, she finds a burden and complains to Gapsun. Meanwhile Hojeong returns from the U.S., bringing back a man with her that she's sure her mother will accept. Migyeong is now dating Sangu and considering marriage whilst Seoyeong has to handle a major case and continues to grow weary of being a judge. Samjae is the one who is truly doing we

Marriage troubles continue between Ujae's parents as their wedding anniversary comes by. Seoyeong gets scouted by Unique Law Firm after the sentencing of her murder trial. She finds it harder by the day to work as a judge. Meanwhile Samjae is continuing to work hard and Sangu's love for Migyeong is deepening. She's worried about telling him the truth whilst Hojeong does what she can to gain some independence from her overly attached mother.

Samjae gets discovered by Ujae and he keeps trying to pay him back for his good dead. Meanwhile Hojeong can't forget Sangu and even proposes to him in the end. Meanwhile, Ujae organizes Seoyeong's father's memorial service at home.

Gyeongho begins work at Sangu and Migyeong's hospital with and air of a love triangle about to blossom. Ujae keeps trying to repay Samjae and even tries to get him a job at the company. Seongjae gets caught for not attending school. And we get a great flashback about the sacrifices that Seoyeong had to make as an older twin...
Samjae ends up working at WINNERS and Seoyeong at Unique. She's shocked by seeing Yeonhui and Seonu but doesn't say a word to Ujae about it. Hojeong declares war on Migyeong for Sangu.

Lee Soon carries out Prince Boksun's execution for attempting treason. Meanwhile, Jang Hyeon seeks out Jo Sa Seok, saying there seems to be a romantic attachment between Ok Jung and Lee Soon. He asks for a straw mat to be laid down through the Grand Queen Dowager's palace.

Lee Soon goes to the seamstress's chamber seeking Ok Jung, saying he has come to have his measurements taken. But not seeing Ok Jung, he is disappointed. Meanwhile, Ok Jung, while struggling with rain-soaked laundry, happens to meet Lee Soon.

Prince Dongpyeong, asking Lee Soon whether he has a woman he loves, says they should share a pleasant chat over a cup of wine. Meanwhile, at Yang Goon's order to bring a blanket, Ok Jung heads toward the office where Lee Soon has fallen asleep.
The Queen Mother has just one wish for Lee Soon who has woken up. It is for him to welcome the queen anew. Meanwhile, Lee Soon hears from Yang Goon that Ok Jung is not in Joseon but China.
Ok Jung enters the palace with the help of the Grand Queen Dowager. Meanwhile, Inhyeon, to keep her promise to Lee Soon, secures a residence where Ok Jung can stay in the palace.
Lee Soon rises to the position of the fourth rank concubine. Meanwhile, Min Yu Jung devises a plot to chase Ok Jung out of the palace.

Veteran Howard Toliver (Michael Dudikoff) works at a prison for extremely dangerous juvenile offenders. Recruited to rescue a wealthy girl being held captive in Vietnam, he assembles a team composed of some of the most violent inmates, many of whom are enemies. After battling their way through the jungle, they lay siege to the fortress of the brutal warlord Vinh Moc (Cary-Hiroyuki Tagawa), who has the hostage hidden away. Over the course of a long, hot Louisiana summer, a 10-year-old black girl, Eve Batiste (Jurnee Smollett), discovers that her family's affluent existence is merely a facade. The philandering of her suave doctor father, Louis (Samuel L. Jackson), creates a rift, throwing Eve's mother, Roz (Lynn Whitfield), and teenage sister, Cicely (Meagan Good), into emotional turmoil. Eve, though, manages to find some solace with her quirky psychic aunt, Mozelle (Debbi Morgan).

Sonic saves a damsel in distress, and falls in love with her, not knowing she's a robot built by Robotnik. But when she has a chance to trap him, she helps him escape, realizing she has fallen for him.

When Scratch and Grounder use Robotnik's new Slo-Mo Ray Gun to capture Sonic, Tails rescues him by reversing the gun and turning it on a tribe of friendly Tree Sloth People who become a high speed commando strike force against Robotnik.

Tails and other Mobius citizens are lured into Robotnik's robotic games of chance, and when they lose they're sent to slave labor camps. Sonic rescues Tails and the others by beating the house in games of chance at Robotnik's Casino.
In order to free Sketch Lampoon (a satirical comic book artist) from Robotnik's new high security prison, Sonic allows himself to be captured, then makes a high speed rescue and escape.

When Tails gets trapped in the "Warp of Confusion" (an Escher-like world of another dimension) by Robotnik's cousin, Dr. Warpnik, Sonic comes to the rescue and traps Robotnik and his badniks in the warp.

When Apple feels left out of a Berryball game and an advanced ballet class, she invents some "groove booties" programmed to dance to any beat. She temporarily impresses her friends with her dance moves, but when the groove booties go out of control and threaten the town's Berryball game, she is forced to fess up.

When the girls discover that Apple's groove booties can teach the pups to dance, Plum gets an idea for a Doggie Dance Show. Wanting to impress them, Huck offers to have TomTom join the show... despite the pup's obvious dislike of performing in public. It's up to Strawberry to help Huck see that he should not force TomTom into something he just doesn't want to do.

When a simple tune Cherry composes goes viral on the Berryweb, Cherry quickly gets fed up with everyone listening to this song, everywhere, all the time. She goes to comic lengths to get some peace so she can compose the song she's suppose to write for the Queen of Berryvania.

Strawberry and Orange are dangling their legs in the stream when something tickles Orange's foot. She is sent squealing from the water, certain an eel is after her. Strawberry good-naturedly chuckles at her antics. But Orange gets her dander up and wades into the water to face her "attacker." When she looks down into the water, gazing up at her is the cutest, most adorable, puffy-cheeked fish she's ever seen. It's love at first sight. Orange has to take him home.

At the next Storytime, Strawberry is going to read a new poem. We see her at the podium as she finishes writing it, one afternoon when no one else is in the café except Custard and Pupcake. Strawberry clears her throat and reads the poem aloud. It's a simple, sweet rhyme about the magic of making wishes on falling stars. She tries a few different rhymes as she goes, noting them on her paper. She is startled to hear applause from Mr. Longface Caterpillar who has heard her recital.

From the BerryWorks to Strawberry's Café, everyone is excited about who will win this year's Spring Flower Festival! Berry Bitty City is decorated with colorful banners proclaiming the big event. Lemon works the hardest. For weeks she has watered her violets by day and sung to them at night, doing everything she can to win first prize. With the contest just a day away, Lemon is at her garden early.

Strawberry Shortcake's friends watch her with wide eyes as she everrrrr-so-gently squirts a layer of blueberry smoothie into a tall glass, trying to not disturb the five other multi-colored layers beneath it. It's her tenth attempt to create the world's first Rainbow Smoothie! She has even painted one wall of her café rainbow colors in honor of the soon-to-be new item on the menu. No one dares breathe for fear of spoiling the delicate touch of a master smoothie-squirter at work.

It's a busy day at Lemon's salon, a charming place that is more than just a hair salon  it's one of favorite places for Strawberry and her friends to relax and socialize. All the girls are getting their hair done for the gala grand opening of Mr. Longface's new lawn-bowling and croquet club. They're spirited and laughing and chatting and having a great time, as Lemon runs from one of her friends to the next, doing hair and nails, serving tea and cookies.

Blueberry ordered some Zippy Gro daisy seeds and planted them in her garden. She is surprised that they've sprouted in less than a day despite their descriptive moniker. Strawberry comes by to admire them and Blueberry is reminded that the new cookbook Strawberry ordered has arrived. Strawberry is excited to try out the new corn muffin recipe, as its level of difficulty will be a challenge for her. Strawberry follows the muffin recipe, mixes the ingredients, and double checks it.

programmes.st: The Berry Best You Can Bee
programmes.d: Strawberry is at Orange's store to mail a birthday card to a friend in Big Bitty City. Just after she drops the card into the mail slot, an ill postal carrier bee sneezes sending envelopes and post cards flying in all directions. The two girls help Jadeybug, a postal clerk, and Postmaster Bee gather up the strewn letters and the ill bee gets sent home from work.

While rehearsing a song alone in her cafe, Strawberry is interrupted by the arrival of Jadeybug. The poor ladybug is stressed out because her twin cousins, Kadiebug and Sadiebug, left her a message that they are coming to visit for a whole week. Jadey is unable to host them because she's having her guest room repainted.

While at Orange's general store to pick up a package, Berrykin Bloom chats with Orange about the pogostick he gave her to help her reach the upper shelves. She is very appreciative. He ends up getting a package of special berry seeds he ordered, not the vacation magazine Orange thought he came for. He explains how the seeds were a better purchase because of all the benefits to the Berryworks but now he can no longer afford a vacation.

Plum decides to hold a dance recital at Strawberry's Café Cabaret stage and sends out a stack of invitations. She forgets, however, to check the sign-up sheet at the Café and schedules it for the same night as Blueberry is scheduled to read to the baby Berrykins. Strawberry tells Plum she cannot hold the recital in the Café on her chosen day because the Café is booked.

All of Berry Bitty City is gathered around to watch the last snowberrykin melt. As the last bit of snow forms a puddle, a cheer goes up, spring is here! It's now time for the annual BerryFest. But with Princess Berrykin out of town on business, who will be the BerryFest Princess and preside over the festival?! Everyone is abuzz with how to go about choosing the Princess and what her duties will be. Postmaster Bee declares the only fair way to go about it is to hold an election. Everyone agrees.

programmes.d:

Egg Story: Mr. Simmons gives the class an assignment to couple up and take care of an egg over the weekend to learn teamwork and responsibility.

Weird Cousin: Arnold's weird cousin, Arnie, arrives for a visit and appears to be the biggest loser to everyone except Lila, the love of Arnold's life.
Baby Oskar: Oskar's wife Susie agrees to watch her cousin's baby, also named Oskar.

Helga Sleepwalks: Helga begins to sleepwalk and ends up walking to Arnold's house. 
Fighting Families: The Fighting Families Contest has come to town and have selected two families: one from PS 118 and PS 119.

Monkeyman!: Arnold is saved from thugs by a mysterious, caped character named Monkeyman.
Buses, Bikes, Subways: Out on a field trip, Harold and Helga miss the bus and get separated from the rest of the class.

Grandpa's sister: Mitzi arrives unexpectedly at the boarding house.
Synchronized Swimming: Coach Wittenberg recruits Arnold's gang for a synchronized swim team.

programmes.t: Hey Arnold!: Helga's Masquerade/Mr. Green Runs
programmes.d:
Helga's Masquerade: When Helga realizes that Arnold is so taken by Lila because of her wit and charm, she decides that the only way to get Arnold to notice her is to be like Lila.
Mr. Green Runs: Arnold helps Mr. Green run for the City Council.

programmes.t: Hey Arnold!: Helga On The Couch
programmes.d: Helga is recommended for counseling after Mr. Simmons observes her berating Arnold, arguing with her parents, etc. She learns that unrequited love is very normal and that she's actually okay.

Washed up balladeer Dino Spumoni fakes his own death in order to increase his record sales.  Everyone believes he's dead and at the funeral, Grandpa and Arnold find out that Dino has left Arnold all his future record sales.
By complete coincidence, Arnold and Helga and family end up at the same beach resort for summer vacation. Helga is ecstatic until Arnold meets Summer, the girl of his dreams.
After a chilling vampire movie, Sid is so spooked that he believes that Stinky has all of the characteristics of a vampire. Olga comes home and wants to be a big sister to a little girl.

Gerald becomes addicted to a game called "The King." When Arnold notices that Gerald is avoiding him and making excuses regarding his whereabouts, he becomes suspicious. Arnold, Sid, Gerald, and Harold go on a fishing trip.
The guys find a bag of money and they want to split it up right away. But Arnold strongly suggests the honest route "to turn the money into the police and keep it if no one claims it."

programmes.st: New Bully On The Block/Phoebe Breaks A Leg
programmes.d: When a new bully comes on the block, Wolfgang feels threatened that he will lose his power over Arnold and the gang. Phoebe breaks her leg when she rescues Helga from the pathway of a speeding bus.

programmes.st: Stuck In A Tree/Rhonda Goes Broke
programmes.d: Arnold tries to help Eugene get out of a tree but gets stuck himself. After a busy day at school of boasting and fashion policing, Rhonda comes home and finds out that they are now broke and have nothing left.

Helga loses her infamous locket and it winds up in the wrong place in Arnold's house. Sid learns that germs are on just about everything people touch and becomes so psychotic about hygiene that he wears a protective suit.

During a game of baseball, Arnold pops a fly ball and it hits Helga in the head. The knock on the head makes her goofy and causes amnesia. Grandpa is paid a visit by his old friend Jimmy, which sparks up his competitive nature.

As the gang passes through the cemetery, Gerald tells the story of the Ghost Bride who murdered her husband-to-be when he left her at the alter and married her sister. Gerald meets Chloe, a cute girl on his block, and instantly falls head over heels.

Harold decides that he hates school and wants nothing else to do with it. But when he gets suspended and can find nothing to do at home, he tries everything he can to go back. Ernie falls in love with a beautiful magazine model.

Arnold pays his cousin Arnie a visit and it turns out to be much like being in The Twilight Zone. Wolfgang tells Chocolate Boy that if he can go two weeks without chocolate, he'll give him ten pounds of chocolate.

programmes.st: Harold And Patty Arm Wrestle/Arnold And The Rich Guy
programmes.d: Harold becomes the King Of Arm Wrestling at PS 118. At a hockey game with Grandpa, Arnold prevents an airborne puck from hitting a stranger in the head.

The Racing Mule/Curly's Girl: Mr. Hyuhn, Ernie and Oskar combine their resources to purchase a racing horse. When Rhonda's dad buys her mother a fur coat for her birthday, the temptation is too great and Rhonda wears it to school.

On The Lam/Family Man: Harold, Stinky, and Sid steal rockets out of the science lab at school and set them off outside an old police station. The deli shop where Mr. Hyunh works has a new owner, and he's looking for a new head chef.
Grandpa enters his packard in the classic car competition. It is admired by all until someone admires it enough to steal it. Phoebe is set to receive an award for her perfect attendance.

programmes.st: A Day in the Life of a Classroom/Big Bob’s Crisis
programmes.d: Mr. Simmons wins The Teacher of the Year award and The Knowledge Channel wants to do a documentary capturing the spontaneous moments in his class. Big Bob has a change of heart when he has what appears to be a heart attack.
Married: Rhonda uses her origami marriage predictor to tell who will marry who within the gang. Everyone becomes curious except Arnold.

Timberly Loves Arnold/Eugene, Eugene: When Gerald tries to get rid of his little sister Timberly, Arnold sticks up for her by. Mr. Leichliter, the theater critic, posts auditions for his rendition of the classic play, "Eugene, Eugene".
Arnold and Gerald are cast as a banana and a strawberry in their school play which is written and directed by Helga./Arnold wrecks Eugene's brand new bike.
Helga drops her journal full of love poems about Arnold into a pile of books./ Arnold's class goes on a field trip to the aquarium where Arnold waits to see Lockjaw.

Helga has been secretly building a shrine in her closet to Arnold.  She has been collecting his combs, old school photos, used band-aids and chewing gum, but only one thing will make the shrine complete: Arnold's hat.

Helga tries to hide her disappointment at not being invited to Rhonda's makeover party.  She gives herself her own makeover and crashes the party with the neighborhood boys in tow, trying to out girlie-girl everyone else at the party.

Arnold and Gerald are invited to a school dance by Connie and Maria; a pair of 6th grade "older women"./Arnold and Gerald manage to scrape up enough money for cheap seats at the last baseball game of Mickey Kaline - Arnold's idol.

Dylan is imprisoned on a prison planet and must stage an escape as his crew tries to stage their own rescue.
Castalians board the Andromeda to finalize the charter for the New Commonwealth. When the leader is discovered dead, Tyr is the main suspect.

programmes.st: The Pearls That Were His Eyes
programmes.d: Beka learns that her father's former business partner deals in a highly addictive drug called Flash. The rest of the crew holds a "garage sale" to earn money for new ship parts.
The Andromeda discovers her "sister ship", the Pax Magellanic.  The crew aboard Pax is 300 years old, but have not aged a day
Tyr crash lands the Eureka Maru on a Nietzschean planet and develops amnesia. He must remember what he is doing before the Nietzscheans discover him and his crate of stolen goods.
Harper receives the "gift" of knowledge from a dying Perseid, only to discover that the Perseid was being hunted by a bounty hunter, who has now turned his attention to Harper.
Dylan is arrested for assassinating a dictator 300 years ago, by the man he helped install in his place. The new dictator ended up being much, much worse.
Andromeda is boarded by a drone from the Consensus of Parts, a mythical mechanical society. While friendly at first, the drone tries to force the ship to join the Consensus.

programmes.st: Fear and Loathing in the Milky Way
programmes.d: Gerentex is back and demands Trance and Harper help him with his new scheme: finding Tarn-Vedra.
Dylan and Rev Bem help a peaceful society stand up to their would-be slavers. They have to be careful because if Dylan teaches them to kill, their kids will be born knowing it.
Dylan attempts to bring peace to two different Nietzschean prides by escorting the princess of one to her arranged marriage to the prince of the other.
Rommie's avatar falls in love with what turns out to be the avatar of a warship named Gabriel. Gabriel attempts to infect Rommie with a virus that broadcasts its plans to the warship.
Beka takes the Andromeda to Tarn-Vedra, but extended time in the slipstream causes side effects. To combat them, Beka starts taking Flash and soon becomes addicted.
An old memory from the Andromeda is accidentally activated, which sends her on a mission and leaves Dylan and the crew unable to override the command.
With the Andromeda damaged by their deadliest enemies, Dylan and Rommie must rescue Tyr, Harper, and Rev from a Magog World ship.
Dylan, Beka, Rev, and Tyr crash land after escaping a gang of Nietzscheans, but soon face a new threat: Rev's need to feed.
The crew must steal a jewel that is at the center of a feud between a Drift owner and the Than. Beka falls for a security chief who was formerly a thief.

The curtains are down on his skirmish with Secco, but Bucciarati must race against time to reach the Colosseum as he realizes his body is nearing the end of the line. Unfortunately, he’s not the only one who catches on to his deteriorating condition.

Key to defeating the Boss in hand, Polnareff waits for Bucciarati and crew. But the one who appears before him first is none other than the Boss of the Passione himself, Diavolo. The tides may not be the only things shifting in the battle yet to come.

Pierced by the arrow, Silver Chariot transforms into Chariot Requiem, its new power swapping the souls of all living creatures nearby. Realizing the dangers of the arrow in the wrong hands, Giorno and crew scramble to get ahold of it before Diavolo does.

Grotesque disfigurations begin to emerge from the soul-swapped bodies as Chariot Requiem’s frenzy rages on. Bucciarati and crew need to take back the arrow and fast. However, Giorno has a terrifying revelation, stopping everyone in their tracks.

Solving the mystery of Requiem, Diavolo takes control of Trish’s soul and steals the arrow. Attacks do nothing against Emperor Crimson’s time leaps and Eulogy’s predictions. But just as Diavolo is about to pierce his own Stand with the arrow...

Righteous actions born of truth shall never be destroyed. Piercing Golden Wind with the arrow, Giorno draws the final battle against Diavolo to a close. And Diavolo, robbed of the mercy of death, spirals violently into an “end” that never ends.

Months before meeting Giorno, Bucciarati and gang help a local florist chisel out the truth behind his daughter’s apparent suicide. Mista is assigned to track down her lover, whose ties with destiny had unwittingly cast a light upon Bucciarati’s fate.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Dio the Invader
programmes.d: On a stormy night in Victorian England, a coach carrying an aristocratic family meets with disaster, forever changing the fate of its sole survivors, George and Jonathan Joestar.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: A Letter From the Past
programmes.d: Hostility grows between Jonathan and his adopted brother, Dio, as forgotten secrets emerge. Do the sinister slums of London hold the secret to the mask and Jonathan’s suspicions?
Jonathan and his new comrade, Speedwagon, confront Dio but are caught off guard when a savage reversal sends shock waves through the Joestar family.
Fate arranges the meeting of a broken Jonathan and the mysterious Zeppeli, master of Hamon energy. Meanwhile, one particularly savage vampire recruit hopes to slice his way to victory.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Dark Knights
programmes.d: Terror follows Jonathan and his fellow travelers to Windknight’s Lot, where they find themselves faced with the devious Dio. The onslaught of evil continues with two colossal knights.
Just as Jonathan’s heroism transforms one foe’s hatred into humanity, an even greater behemoth drives the crew to a knightly training camp, complete with a medieval chamber of death.

Conquering his own fear, an unlikely star opens an opportunity for Zeppeli and Jonathan. But as a prophecy from Zeppeli’s past unfolds dramatically in a clash of life, death, and succession, a true hero triumphs.

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Bloody Battle! JoJo & Dio
programmes.d: With sword in hand and a team of Hamon masters at his side, Jonathan sets out to save Poco’s sister. When one slithery demon makes its move, Jonathan steps in, igniting an all-out war with his “brother.”

programmes.t: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: The Final Ripple!
programmes.d: Jonathan takes Erina’s hand in marriage before embarking on a celebratory journey to America. But two stowaways unwittingly change the course of history for all those onboard.

The Power of Veto is on the line, who will find light in the darkness and win the golden power?

It's the return of the legendary OTEV in a history-making competition. Who will win the Power of Veto, and will it be used to save Kimo or Angela? Plus, with Angela's life on the line, her paranoia returns. Will it upend the game again?

Will Makensy keep the Veto streak alive, and save Angela? And if so, will it be Leah or Quinn who puts up in her place? Who will be the first Houseguest sent to the Jury? Ainsley has a big announcement!  What's next with the BB A.I. twist? Jerry O'Connell
The BB A.I. twist becomes twisted. Plus who will become the new Head of Household and who will they nominate?
The Power of Veto is up for grabs at Jankie World. Plus, there will be a second Veto on the line. How will it work?
Either T'Kor or Rubina will be sent to Jury.  Who will the House evict from Jankie World?  The Head of Household competition begins, Live!

Ryan's all-new 9Mag shop is open for business with a fresh talent lineup. Van takes over the old shop by marking his territory with a new set of rules. Phor is back from hiatus and learns that not everyone has access to Ryan's new kingdom.

Van's leadership skills are put under the microscope, as the old shop continues to suffer. Meanwhile, Lily wonders if she still has a future at 9Mag. Charmaine's parents come to town and Phor receives a baller opportunity.
When Ryan decides to treat the new 9Mag and old 9Mag to a team-building trip in Miami, Charmaine questions her future with 9Mag and an emotional Ryan releases some pent-up anger towards the OGs.

Mandatory team bonding in Miami pays off as Charmaine and Lily put years of beef behind them. Phor makes his triumphant return to the stage. When Lily lashes out at Neek, Ryan's hard-won 9MAG peace goes left. Charmaine faces a heartbreaking decision.

programmes.st: The Cover Up Is Worse Than The Crime
programmes.d: Van defends himself and his artwork against a few unhappy clients causing legal trouble for Ryan. While Don and Ashley view houses at the top of their non-existent budget, a familiar face returns for a second chance at life and love at 9MAG.

programmes.st: What Is This, A Reunion Show?
programmes.d: The 9MAG crew--past and present--takes over the Chicago Tattoo Convention, digging up buried conspiracy theories and dragging old rivalries into the ground.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew You Got Some Stupid Ears
programmes.d: Puma decides to invite Ceaser to his wedding on the condition that he leaves Dutchess at home. Walt's frustrating search comes to an end when a letter arrives at the shop with information about his father. Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew Tell the Truth and Shame the Devil
programmes.d: O'S**t's baby mamas, Coley and Kathy, face each other for the first time since their violent "family meal." Ceaser is torn between his friends and his woman as Dutchess reacts negatively to not being invited to Puma's wedding. Presented by VH1.

When O'S**t reappears at the shop, Walt tears into him about friendship and responsibility. After fighting in Jamaica together, Dutchess runs from the resort and, unbeknownst to Ceaser, ends up collapsing in the parking lot. Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew From Wedlock to Headlock
programmes.d: The crew are having the time of their lives in Jamaica but are shocked when Ceaser suddenly sends Dutchess packing! At the wedding, the crew is left wondering if this Black Ink love story will have an unhappy ending. Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew Cease and Desist
programmes.d: The crew is back in Harlem, making money and wilin' out. All is back to normal, except for one thing…no Dutchess. Meanwhile, on the other side of Harlem, Puma throws a grand opening party for his new shop, Ink 124. Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew We All Got Problems
programmes.d: O'S**t goes to court, where he learns some unsettling information about his case. Dutchess and Puma attempt to make amends. While Dutch tattoos DJ Whoo Kidd at the shop, Ceaser makes a decision that is bound to change everything. Presented by VH1.

Ceaser got caught cheating on Dutchess and he needs his brother Ty's help getting his things from her apartment. Dutch confides in Sky, putting Sky's loyalty to Ceaser to the test. O S**t  asks Puma to accompany him ring shopping. Presented by VH1.

programmes.st: Black Ink Crew Baby Mama Role Call
programmes.d: Ceaser faces Dutchess for the first time since she kicked him out of the apartment. Dutchess decides to see a plastic surgeon about breast implants. O'S**t decides it's time to get all three of his baby mamas together for a dinner.  Presented by VH1.

O'S**t's past has come back to haunt him when a mystery woman turns up at the shop. While Dutch reconnects with everyone but Ceaser. During the party, Cease and Puma have an idea that has the potential to change Black Ink's future. Presented by VH1.

With Dutchess doing her own thing, Ceaser focuses on the shop and all of the drama that comes with it. An already crazy mixxxy party gets interesting when O'S**t and new shop apprentice Donna are caught in the bathroom together. Presented by VH1.
O'S**t's attorney, Paul Lieber, pulls some strings in the courtroom in attempt to get O'S**t out of his legal mess. Dutchess invites Quani on her upcoming trip to Paris. Presented by VH1.

Just before Danny is to give witness testimony at a Peruvian drug lord's murder trial, Linda is kidnapped. This drug lord has a history of intimidating witnesses.
Danny and Jackie investigate the cut-throat world of fashion after Linda's runway model niece and a reporter are poisoned at a fashion show.
Frank's frustrations rise when the media sensationalizes the murder of a tourist shot and killed outside a trendy Lower East Side restaurant.
Ben helps a convict win a parole only to have the man later become the chief suspect in a bank robbery.
Hoss relies on clever attorney Whitney Parker, who has a drinking problem, to clear him of a murder charge.
Hoss is seriously injured internally and Ben seeks help from the only doctor within 50 miles, who happens to be in prison for murder.
In what is arguably the best comedy of the series, Hoss swears he has seen green elves running around the Ponderosa and a smooth-talking Irishman complicates matters even worse.
Ben and Hoss unwittingly aid a vengeful army colonel who plans to wipe out every Indian he can with a Gatling gun.
Joe teaches Johnny Chapman how to use a gun for defense.  What Joe doesn't see is the deadly consequences that it has in the long run when Johnny becomes a gunfighter.
Juan Ortega claims he has a land grant which gives him ownership of the entire Nevada Territory.
Ben's attempt to rehabilitate an alcoholic singer he knew in better days are complicated by her involvment with a former prize fighter.
Cousin Muley Jones returns to the Ponderosa, along with a pack of noisy hound dogs, in this funny sequel to "The Saga Of Muley Jones".
Hoss is conned into buying a violin from a gypsy fortune teller, and everyone on the Ponderosa--except for Hop Sing--suffers the consequences.
A peaceful Indian is framed for the kidnapping of a young girl, a stunt which ends of tragedy.
Ben becomes irritable and reckless when the completion of an important timber contract is hindered by an old rival.
Joe becomes romantically involved with a woman who considers herself a serious dramatic actress.  Unfortunately, she is the only one who does.

Joe has a run-in with Calamity Jane, and takes her home with him after promising her dying father to take care of her.
In this entertaining episode, laced with humor, Hoss first meets mountain man Jim Leyton.  Bing Russell makes his first appearance as Deputy Clem Foster.

Osuka Kamakura is kidnapped for ransom along with Himawari.
Eiki tries to expose Kawaki’s true identity to drive a wedge between him and Kae.

programmes.d: Hana and Kawaki return to class, and life at the Academy gradually goes back to normal.
Kawaki and Himawari’s class goes on a field trip to an uninhabited island.
The assassin targeting Kae’s life has finally been revealed.

Kae has been taken away and Kawaki must face a dangerous assassin.

After Paige and Henry leave for their honeymoon, Cupid 'Coop' takes Phoebe on a journey through her past romances in an attempt to revive her excitement for love.

Piper & Leo, with help from Coop's ring, must travel back in time to change the events that lead to the deaths of Piper's sisters and the manor's destruction.

Sisters Prue (Shannen Doherty) and Piper (Holly Marie Combs) Halliwell have recently moved into their dead grandmother’s old Victorian home in the San Francisco hills and when youngest, black-sheep sister Phoebe (Alyssa Milano) moves in with them.

programmes.st: I've Got You Under My Skin

After being killed by Asian gang thugs, Mark (guest star John Cho) becomes a ghost whose soul is up for grabs depending upon if Yama (guest star Rex Peterson), the demon who confiscates souls for hell gets him first.

After Piper (Holly Marie Combs) and Phoebe (Alyssa Milano) cast a spell to dream up romantic interests, the dream sorcerer (guest star Matt Schulze) tries to get back at Prue (Shannen Doherty) after she rebuffs him at a nightclub.

When a popular entertainer meets with an untimely death, his shocked showbiz associates scramble desperately to find a quick replacement.

Everyone gets into the act when Maude recruits her family and friends to sing and dance for a questionable charity telethon on the annual musical.

One of the girlfriends of a young charmer learns that he has robbed a bank.
In order to stop a psychotic priest killer, Lt. Stone goes undercover as a Roman Catholic priest. The victims were all clergymen who studied at the same seminary.
A cop who finds out that he has a terminal illness sets out to kill a racketeer who's been his quarry for the last year and a half.
A controversial television interviewer telephones a shadowy figure named Harry Armitage for the "hot seat" segment of his show, accusing Armitage of bribery and influence peddling.
A young woman who has entered a county fair competition in a rural community north of Los Angeles disappears, and her wealthy father hires Joe Mannix to look for her.
Mannix helps his carnival owner friend find out if any of the workers are causing accidents that might be attempts on her life.
The lovely niece of a Korean War veteran is killed with a blow to her neck, and Mannix looks at evidence that suggests an ex-member of his old army unit murdered her.

A friend of Betty's supposedly dies while going for a walk, but she uncovers evidence that he may have been murdered. The wife of her late friend hires her to further investigate and she soon believes embezzlement may be the motive.

J.R.'s friend is wrongly accused of assaulting a man who later dies. Making matters worse, he ran from the scene of the crime making him look guilty. J.R. does every thing he possibly can to help his friend clear himself.

Barnaby is conned into helping another private investigator find a missing girl. But he's not honest with Barnaby about all that is involved with her disappearance or that he's tried to extort money from the people that are looking for her.
J.R, poses as a photographer to find out why a man broke into the real photographers studio and was desperate enough to throw acid on her to get away with the negatives from her last photo shoot.

programmes.st: Love Thy Neighbor - Take his Wife
programmes.d: Steve McGarrett and Five-O are on a mission to find the kidnapper of a wealthy land developer's wife. Despite evidence pointing to militant ecologist Ben Tanaka, McGarrett has doubts and continues to investigate to uncover the true culprit.

Trying to identify and bag the burglars who have been heisting a fortune in gold stored
at various dental-supply warehouses, McGarrett sends an undercover agent into a
rehabilitation institution for delinquent youths in hopes of securing a lead.
McGarrett finds himself in Hong Kong, half-drowned, half-drugged, with amnesia, as he once again pursues his perennial antagonist, Wo Fat, now the key figure in the theft of some deadly nerve gas.

Operating with daring, and virtually under the nose of Five-O Chief Steve McGarrett, Hawaiian history museum curator Arthur Lambert secretly plots to turn criminal and stage the biggest bank robbery in Island annals.

Honolulu prostitutes are being murdered, and those who have not been are living in terror. McGarrett feels sure the murderer's game is extortion — a demand accompanied by a death threat which is carried out if the demand is not met.

Ronette is attacked in her hospital bed by an unseen person. Jean Renault, brother of Jacques and Bernard, plans to blackmail Ben Horne for the release of Audrey. Donna meets with Harold Smith, a shut-in who had befriended Laura.
When Hunter and McCall investigate the alleged death of reporter Ralph Ormond they uncover an extortion plot involving George Shadwell a wealthy industrialist.
Hunter and McCall become suspicious when a Bel Air housewife refuses to identify the man who robbed her of a million-dollar necklace.
Hunter and McCall investigate the mysterious death of Allegra, Hunter's former girlfriend.

When resident Paul Brewer is killed, it's the second murder in a month at the exclusive gated community, Hillview Estates. With no leads on the killer, Steve goes undercover as Dr. Steve Brewer, a community resident.
Personal grievances get in the way of detective Harry Trumble's retirement party. Trumble never forgave Dr. Sloan for marrying his college sweetheart and dedicated his life to his work.

Dr. Sloan treats Amanda and Jesse to lunch to acknowledge Amanda's medical examiner investigation award. Unfortunately, their festivities are interrupted when a young man collapses in the hotel restaurant wearing only a bathrobe.
An assassin is in Dallas to kill an ambassador. A Russian agent who has been tracking the assassin for 25 years asks Walker to help with the capture and prevent the murder.

Walker tells children a Christmas story about a Texas Ranger from 1876. Hayes Cooper was said to have no Christmas spirit. In 1876, a baby was kidnapped and Haynes was assigned the case. At last, he found the baby and Christmas spirit.

Walker transports a mob accountant on a plane so he can testify in court. The mob leader wants him dead, so he causes the plane to crash. Walker and the survivors must find their way from the crash site to safety while the mob chases them.

The Rangers and friends take troubled children to CDs ranch for a weekend camp. Brooks, from an earlier episode, is there for community service. One boy takes money from a drug dealer at a restaurant, and now the criminals are after them.
Kimble is held as a virtual prisoner by an old man who has shunned civilization for fourteen years.
A seedy professional mind reader recognizes Richard Kimble and believes he's found the means to a comeback in a show business.
A new witness, one who saw the one-armed man, comes forward on behalf of Dr. Richard Kimble.
When former mobster Jimmy "The Eraser's" new identity is exposed, MacGyver is forced into action to save Jimmy's daughter and grandson.
While hiking through remote wilderness, MacGyver uncovers an elaborate scheme to siphon oil from a pipeline when he comes to the aid of a young girl, terrorized by the legendary Sasquatch.
MacGyver teams up with the sister of a murdered friend to expose a diamond heist operation that they suspect is the work of a diplomat, using his status to shield him from suspicion and arrest.

A down-on-his-luck shoe salesman, Al Bundy, who’s unhappily married with two children, is forced to choose between going to a basketball game or joining his lazy wife, Peg, in meeting their new neighbors.

Marcy introduces Peg to a new energetic diet to improve her marriage. Al, meanwhile, wants to part of it but learns if he tries the diet, he can persuade Peg to quit. He must then swallow his pride and admit to Peggy he loves her no matter what.
All of the Douglases fall in love at the same time.
Chip has no mother to provide a recipe for a contest.
Chip tries to join a club of older schoolmates.
Robbie must somehow go on a date and write a history paper in one weekend.
Mrs. Wilson knits several baby booties to use as covers for a new set of golf clubs, and Dennis quickly spreads word around the neighborhood.
Mr. Wilson wins an essay contest that requires the entrants to be parents, so he tries to pass off Dennis and his friends as his own children.
Dennis and Tommy decide to use pigeons in the park to send messages to each other.
Mr. Wilson becomes a cat-catcher for the police department to help enforce a cat license law.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: The Historical Andersons
programmes.d: Bud is given an assignment to write an essay about a great man from the War of Independence.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: The Grass is Greener
programmes.d: In college Jim was spent so much time with his four college pals that they were known as the Four Musketeers. Charly Bradley, one of his college pals, is in town.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: The Persistent Guest
programmes.d: Bud has a new friends that he has invited to stay over night at the Anderson Home.
Margaret is excited about her family reunion. Her excitement is not shared by the family. They have found all kinds of excuses to prevent them from going to her reunion.
Emily Turner plays matchmaker to Mr. French and Miss Faversham while being the match-breaker for her son Jim Turner and Cissy's relationship.
Buffy & Jody make a new friend with Johnnie. Johnnie and his mother are hiding from militants who are interested in finding their father.
Russ Brook is a former friend of Cissy's who is now in the Peace Corps. Russ asks Cissy to join him on a mission to Chile.
Buffy wants to join a popular group at school, but the group does not think she is right for them.

Bobby doesn't want to be safety monitor for his class because his classmates now hate him. However, he soon abuses his power and begins reporting on his family when they break house rules. Meanwhile, the family salvages an old sailboat.
Bobby becomes obsessed with Jesse James. Mike and Carol don't approve of his new hero, and try to find a way to convince him that James was nothing but a "mean, dirty killer."
Marcia breaks a date with Charlie when "big man on campus" Doug Simpson asks her out. However, after she gets hit in the nose with a football, Doug Simpson breaks his date with her.

Peter gets a job at the bike shop, but he is fired after three days. He doesn't want to tell his parents the bad news, because he told the family he might be getting a promotion to salesman the day he got fired.

Cindy loses her mom's earrings after playing with them, and "detective" Peter Brady tries to solve the mystery. But when Carol wants the earrings for a costume ball and they're still not found, the entire family tries to crack the case.
The Brady girls try to play matchmaker between Carol's free-spirited grandmother and stick-in-the-mud Grandpa Brady.

Gloria, Mike, and Archie plan for Edith 50th birthday surprise party at the Stivics house. Edith comes home while Archie and the Stivics leave. A knock at the door reveals a cop who claims that there's a rapist in town but he slips out that it's him.

When Edith tells the story to the family in tears, Gloria and Mike believe she should report to the police. Gloria gets a call from the policemen asking her to identify the rapist. Edith is afraid, but  Archie takes Edith to the police station.

On the eve of his grand opening, Harry quits Archie's bar when the bigot bosses Harry around. Helpless, Edith and the Stivics come on time and gladly decide to help out. With a great crowd, Archie faces more problems.

programmes.st: Archie And The Ku Klux Klan: Part 2
programmes.d: Archie devises a plan to prevent the Klan from burning a cross on Mike and Gloria's lawn.
A despondent Archie retreats to his bedroom, until Harry offers to bail him out with a partnership offer for the bar.
The family relives Mike and Gloria's blind date where they first insulted each other and ended up having sex in the kitchen.
Edith's religious faith is shaken after her friend, female impersonator Beverly LaSalle, is brutally murdered by street thugs at Christmas.
Mike is put in the hospital and Beverly LaSalle is murdered by a thug at Chistmas.
Iola declares her independence from her mother … and moves in with Mama.  Now, the family unites with a single purpose: to get Iola out of the house.

Things change for a middle-class couple (Alan Alda, Carol Burnett) and two other couples they vacation with four times a year.
When a woman is found murdered in her mobile home, police make two shocking discoveries--her husband may not only have been the killer, but he may have also killed his first wife 31 years before.

A new fingerprint identification system helps detectives track down a killer after three years of searching. And a Georgia investigator gets to the bottom of a 16-year-old murder case when he discovers the victim's body -- in the bottom of a well.

programmes.st: Killer on Campus / The Bow Hunter
programmes.d: Thirty-two years after the killing of University of Michigan law student Jane Mixer, police use DNA found on her pantyhose to finally track down the killer.
A boy's toy Batmobile car provides an important clue for detectives struggling to make a case against a serial killer who stalks and kills waitresses.

A 23-year-old teacher vanished the evening before Easter after giving confession. Her body was later found floating in a drainage canal. At the time, a key witness hinted that a member of the Catholic clergy may have been responsible.

A 14-year-old boy is charged with the murder of his sister, but his public defender believes the real killer is still on the loose. And two deteriorated slides, made 16 years earlier, give police the evidence they need to reopen the cold case.

programmes.st: The Flaming Gorge Falls/Caught In The Mail
programmes.d: A man suspected of the cold case murder of his wife and son hatches a new plot to kill his mother and father; and detectives solve the 20-year-old murder of a teenager by tricking her killer into licking an envelope.

When a Nevada couple demands the return of a baby they had sold to another couple, the burned body of the baby turns up in Arizona. Then, a man discovers a barrel in his crawlspace that contains the body of a woman who has been dead for decades.

programmes.st: Mistaken for a Killer/The Boy and the Monster
programmes.d: Advances in DNA technology that take place over 20 years help police to finally identify the man who brutally stabbed two women to death.
In August 1972, the body of Jody Loomis is found in the woods. 34 years later, the killer's DNA is recovered from Jody's old clothing but it isn't matched until 2018.

In Wisconsin, advances in forensic clay modeling help investigators identify a murder victim whose skin was stripped from her head, neck, and legs. And in California, police track down two boys who enjoy satanic rituals and setting fires.
Firefighter Gary Parks is killed in a fire ruled arson, the investigation into his death shifts to homicide. A serial arsonist is thought to be the culprit.
Law enforcement officials fear they may have to release a serial killer from prison until a 24-year-old murder case gives them a chance to lock him up for good.
Police in Overland Park, Kansas, hunt for over 15 years for a serial killer who lures women to Kansas for sadomasochistic sexual trysts at hotels.
In July of 1970, the brutal murder of single mom Loretta Jones leaves four-year-old Heidi motherless. Nearly 40 years later, she vows to solve her mother's cold case.
The murder of a 73-year-old man leads police on a long chase for a man who's suspected of identity theft and bears a rose tattoo with the name "Phyllis".

The Morgendorffers reluctantly attend a family wedding in which Daria and Quinn are bridesmaids, and Daria finds something in common with her Aunt Amy.

programmes.st: That Was Then, This is Dumb
programmes.d: Helen and Jake realize how much they've changed while spending a weekend with their friends from college, and Jane and Daria join Trent on a trip to the flea market.
Daria and Jane record a film about Quinn's daily life for a school project with the hopes of making her look ridiculous, but Daria's conscience begins to weigh on her.
While working on the school yearbook, Daria takes a liking to a formerly homeschooled student with many eccentricities.
When Daria and Jodie are invited to tour a school for gifted students, their parents struggle to get along, and Quinn finds herself at odds with her own friends.
Rumors begin to swirl at school when a mysterious rash sends Daria to the hospital.
Abbi and Ilana are going on a trip, but getting to the airport proves to be much harder than they expected.
When Abbi gets her period while on an airplane, she and Ilana go to extreme lengths to find a tampon.

programmes.d: Sarah sues "Home Alone," and Brian seeks revenge on a bird who repeatedly poops on him.

In order to raise enough money for their rent, the guys create a public access wrestling show.
When the guys head to the North Rancho College Job Fair on business, Ders feuds with Coast Guard officers while Adam and Blake pursue their dreams elsewhere on campus.
The TelAmeriCorp employees become fiercely competitive during an office blood drive.
Adam and his rambunctious father hijack Gramps DeMamp's funeral.
Blake declares war on Adam and Ders after they kick him out of their new band.
A wild night at a neighbor's house leads the guys to question the nature of their relationship.
Andre and Meegan have a serious talk, a rapper runs into trouble while trying to storm out of an interview, and an airline passenger adapts to life in economy plus.
Ghostbusters singer Ray Parker Jr. unveils his lesser-known songs, a young man is transported to a magical land, and Jordan and Keegan reach their final destination.
Jordan and Keegan trade stories about a forbidden word, while President Obama's anger gets translated.
President Obama rap battles, and a traffic reporter has some trouble flying.

Nathan makes it easier for parents to have sex in a hotel room and finds a way for a travel agent to better serve her aging customers.
The guys court legendary newscaster Mort Crim to be the celebrity spokesperson for one of their clients, and Ned ramps up security in the building.
Sam starts acting Blacker in a bid to impress his new girlfriend, Tim gets roped into spending time with a widower, and Chrissy has trouble hitting it off with a new co-worker.
The Reno Sheriff's Department takes more than seven hours to respond to a liquor store robbery.
Garcia breaks up Dangle's wedding in more ways than one, and Terry the prostitute finds someone to love.
Tommy Hawk, bounty hunter, and reality TV star runs afoul of the Reno Sheriff's Department.
When two members of a conspiracy group in Roswell, New Mexico perish in quick succession, the BAU is called to investigate. (TV-14 L, V)
The team travels to Miami to track a killer who murders sex workers in a style similar to animal slayings.
When teenagers who were reported missing are suspected of a series of mass murders in Chicago, the BAU investigates their whereabouts to find a motive for the crimes.
When a series of backyard pool homicides are reported in California, the BAU team team searches for an UnSub with a puzzling past.

The BAU believes two unsubs may be operating at the same time, when victims killed in two drastically different ways are discovered in the same city. Also, the team grapples with keeping Reid safe in prison. (TV-14 L, V)
When a body is discovered in Atlanta covered in scratches, the BAU finds that this death and subsequent murders could be linked to an UnSub with an obsessive skin disorder.
As Rossi conducts a profiling course on his birthday, he receives a call from his serial killer nemesis, Tommy Yates (Adam Nelson), telling him the location of his latest victim. (TV-14 L, V)
When the BAU goes to San Jose to investigate a string of murders, Garcia delves into her hacker past and reconnects with her old flame to help the team with the case.
The BAU team travels to Denver to investigate several murders.
When several women go missing in Virginia, the BAU must figure out what they have in common in order to find them.

The BAU investigates random murders in northern Virginia and searches for a conflicted UnSub who has an uncontrollable urge to kill but is also filled with remorse. Rossi receives a visit from a woman who could hold a secret from his past.

When several federal government employees, including a close friend of Walker's, succumb to symptoms of a heart attack, the BAU investigates. Also, Reid anxiously awaits his trial date. Jane Lynch guest stars.
When an UnSub targets the BAU, the team goes into action to find out who is responsible.
The BAU team searches for a serial killer along the Appalachian Trail in rural Virginia. (TV-14 L, V)

When victims are found in Philadelphia in a similar style to victims of The Replicator, the stalker who has been tracking the BAU's every move, the team thinks this could be the break they need to try and apprehend him.
The BAU investigates the cause of several fatal car crashes involving drivers and pedestrians. Also, Reid gets bad news. (TV-14 L, V)

When the daughters of Bruce Morrison, a writer whose wife mysteriously vanished a year ago, go missing on the anniversary of their mother's disappearance, the BAU is brought in to study Morrison as a possible suspect.

Victoria makes preparations for her wedding while Eve makes plans to prevent it.
Jeff calls off the wedding and goes to the cemetery to locate Peter Bradford's grave.

Victoria tries to convince Jeff to wait for the police instead of running away.
Angelique visits the Netherworld and tells Diabolos that Nicholas is in love with Maggie.
Diabolos orders Nicholas to sacrifice Maggie in a black mass so they may be together.
Nicholas revives Tom Jennings and orders him to attack Victoria.
In a crypt, Barnabas battles Tom and confronts him with a crucifix.
Amy Jennings is glad when her brother Chris decides to stay in Collinsport.
Barnabas tries to prevent the new experiment to bring Eve back to life.
Adam kidnaps Victoria and attempts to conduct the experiment himself.
Professor Stokes prepares to send Adam to a clinic to remove his scars.
After they are married, Victoria watches in horror as Jeff fades away.
On her way to the Old House, Elizabeth hears an animal growling in the woods.
Elizabeth brings Amy to stay at Collinwood. Amy and David explore the west wing.
David and Amy hold a seance to contact the spirit of Quentin Collins.
Professor Stokes tells Victoria that she can be with Jeff only if she dies.
During a seance to contact Jeff, the spirit of Magda speaks through Carolyn.
Amy tells David that Quentin is angry. Spirits visit them as they enter the west wing.
Roger discovers David and Amy are missing. David hears Quentin's music and searches for him.

A ratings war sparks a wave of deaths across the big TV networks - a magician impales himself on a bed of spikes, and Dr Danger also turns up dead.
With the latest murder on TV taking place at Community General, Dr. Sloan, Steve, Jesse, and Amanda prepare to solve this case and protect their integrity.

Steve assigns Amy Devlin and Taylor Lucas, two police officers from the Vice Squad, to assist in solving the homicide of local pimp Milton Wilder. However, Taylor convinces her partner to take a temporary detour on their way to the investigation.

programmes.st: Today Is The Last Day Of The Rest Of My Life
programmes.d: The new attending physician, Kate Delibe, is causing a stir at Community General with her unorthodox methods of care. Delibe assists terminally ill patient George Dugan's suicide against Dr. Sloan's wishes.
As Lou Summers heads to the comedy club to host Mark's Man of the Year Roast, a driver in a nearby car shoots at him and misses, but Lou doesn't hear it because his hearing aids aren't on.

Dr. Mark Sloan is caught between family and professional loyalties as his brother Stacy, and medical student Daniel, are both implicated in a mysterious series of events that end in an accidental death.
Steve responds to a call where earlier a man chased another man out of a store with a gun.
When Dr. Wesley, Dean of the medical school, is arrested for sale of narcotics, she pleads her innocence to Mark. Meanwhile, Mark's student Quinn and neighbor Jennifer plan to marry.
While out on his morning jog, Jesse unsuccessfully attempts to save a man who has locked himself in his gargage with the engine running, an apparent suicide.
After Madison hears that Lisa, a personal friend and one of her star students, has missed a few classes, she visits her and finds Lisa comatose from a drug overdose.
It's a case of mistaken identity when Greg, a mobster who looks just like Mark, is released from prison and moves into Mark's neighborhood.
Jesse operates and removed the bullet from Greg, thinking he is Mark. But everything starts to unfold when mark show up for his shift at the hospital.
Mark's patient and shock-jock radio talk show host Denise announces her nation-wide search for her birth mother and jokes that she'll kill her if she doesn't want anything to do with her.
A woman is murdered during the burglary of her opulent Malibu home, a burglary in which a rare diamond, part of a set of famous Russian jewels known as The Seven Deadly Sins, is stolen.
As preparations for the hospital's Christamas party swing into high gear, Claude, a popular hospital maintenance man, who each year portrays Santa Claus at the big bash, collapses.

Dora and Boots set out to help King Juan el Bobo find his crown so we can all go to his Mamí's birthday party. Where did the forgetful king put his crown?
Abuela gives Dora and Boots a present for Dora's new puppy, but they'll have to watch out for Swiper, who's got a bunch of new swiping tricks up his sleeves.

Dora has some really exciting news to tell us: Someone new is joining Dora's family! Someone who sleeps in a cradle, drinks from a bottle, wears diapers, and likes to be rocked to sleep. Can you guess who it is? That's right!
Oh, no! Dora left her music homework in Boots' room. It's a song in English and Spanish, and she needs Boots to bring it to her school so she can sing it to the class.

Dora's baby brother and sister just love bananas, but they also love stories! So Dora tells them a Super Babies story! The Super Babies have to get their bananas back from that Super Villain Swiper the Fox.

Dora and all her friends are at the Super Adventure Race! To win the race, they have to make it across the Troll's tricky Bridge, past the Volcano filled with gooey balls, over the giant Wall, and all the way to the finish line.
It's summertime, and Dora and Boots are having a blast at the beach. But suddenly, they encounter the strangest sight - a snowman in Summer? What's wrong with this picture? Oh, no!
Dora and Boots are hiking on Rainbow Rock when they come across a shy rainbow, Arco Iris, hiding behind a waterfall.
Dora and Boots are having a blast at the beach when all of a sudden they hear a call for help. It's a baby crab stuck in a net!
Dora and Boots are playing catch when they discover a lost baby fox. And he wants his mommy! Just then, Swiper shows up to swipe Boots' superball.

It's a bright, sunny morning, and Dora wants to say hello to her baby brother and sister. But when Dora gets to their room, she sees that the babies have climbed into their baby carriage and are heading for danger!

programmes.st: Dora and Diego to the Rescue!
programmes.d: It's a high-speed, around-the-world adventure as Dora and her cousin Diego chase after Boots, who's being carried off on his giant kite by a mighty wind. Dora and Diego need YOUR help as they cross the ocean.

It's Clean-Up the Beach Day, as Dora and Boots are cleaning up garbage when they find a Singing Clam, who tells them the story of Mariana the Mermaid.  Mariana lives in the Mermaid Kingdom at the bottom of the ocean.

All over the world, everyone's celebrating Friendship Day!  But when Swiper mistakenly swipes all the special glowing Friendship Bracelets, Dora needs to team up with him to bring them back to the Friendship Parades.

programmes.st: Dora's Dance to the Rescue - HOUR SPECIAL
programmes.d: Put on your dancing shoes, because Dora needs you to spin, shake wiggle, jump and clap with her as she tries to rescue Swiper the fox, who's been trapped inside a bottle by a mean dancing elf.
Dora and Boots are exploring in the forest when they discover the gate to Fairy-Tale Land and enter this magical place. But...there's a mean witch who lives in Fairy-Tale Land.
Yo ho ho! Dora and Boots and all their friends are putting on a pirate show today for their mommies and daddies.
Dora's twin brother and sister have been sick, and she wants to buy them a present to cheer them up. Way up on a toy store shelf, she finds a dusty Jack-in-the-Box.

It's Twins Day, and everyone's getting ready for the big Twins Day party at Play Park! Dora even has a surprise for her puppy Perrito. He has a twin too—a long-lost puppy brother he hasn't seen since they were babies.

"Happy Three Kings Day!" Dora, Boots, and Diego are dressed up as kings for the big Three Kings Day party. They'll be bringing a horse, a camel, and an elephant to carry the presents and treats for the party, but Swiper scares the animals away!

Dora and Isa are planting Isa's special unicorn flowers when suddenly a baby unicorn, Unicornio, rides in on a rainbow. He's thrilled to see Isa's beautiful flowers because they're his Mami's favorite.

Benny is so excited—it's his first time in the Big Go-Cart Race, where everyone races in homemade go-karts! But when the whistle blows, Benny's cart backfires and falls to pieces. But Dora and Boots won't let him give up.
Boots and Tico are really excited because it's their first day of school ever—and in their new school, they'll learn in English and Spanish!

Backpack, Backpack, yeah!!! Today's the Backpack Parade, where everyone dresses up their backpacks in different costumes. Backpack is super excited because this year she gets to lead the parade with her song.

"Special delivery for Boots the monkey!" Boots' favorite boots are back from the shoe shop, but when he tries them on, he starts to bounce, bounce, bounce. These aren't his boots—these are bouncy boots.
Dora reads us a Mayan story about twin brothers who were amazing ball players. A long time ago in a Mayan kingdom, there was a big ball game championship.

programmes.st: Dora Saves the Three Little Piggies
programmes.d: Dora and Boots are reading their favorite story, "The Three Little Pigs" when suddenly we hear the piggies calling out for help. Their brick house is missing some bricks, and the Big Bad Wolf is going to blow it down!

programmes.st: The Big Red Chicken's Magic Show
programmes.d: ABRACADABRA! The Big Red Chicken's putting on a magic show for all of his friends. With an "abracadabra," he pulls a rabbit out of his hat, but when it's time to make the bunny disappear, it doesn't work!

It's Junk Day and Benny's showing Dora and Boots his wagon of cool junk. But when the junk truck accidentally takes Backpack and Map off to the junkyard, it's up to Dora, Boots, and Benny and his wagon of stuff to rescue them!

It's naptime for the twins, and Dora has a special Super Babies naptime story. Once upon a time, the Super Babies were getting ready for their nap, but the Dream Fairy never showed up because she was still asleep!
Sully is injured trying to rescue Cloud Dancing from the Army.
Dr. Mike goes into labor in the wilderness, and her baby is born.
Dr. Mike leads a rescue party when Sully and Cloud Dancing are among the passengers in a massive train wreck.
Dr. Mike considers giving up medicine as she tries to cope with being a wife, mother and career woman.
When a baby dies under Dr. Mike’s care, she is sued for malpractice.
When a famous singer comes to town, Dr. Mike fears that Colleen may surrender her dream of becoming a doctor.
Prejudice comes to Colorado Springs as Dr. Mike and Sully try to help a young Latin-American woman when her husband is killed.
Dr. Mike is faced with the prospect of leaving Colorado Springs when Sully is offered a job surveying the new Yellowstone National Park.
Jake and Preston each want Dr. Mike’s endorsement when they run against one another for mayor -- until she is arrested.
Dr. Mike tries to reunite a father and son before it's too late.
Dr. Mike, Sully and Matthew join forces with a legendary marshal to track down the outlaws who wounded Matthew during a robbery.
Colorado Springs prepares for Thanksgiving, unaware of a deadly approaching storm that could destroy the town.
Dr. Mike, Sully and Brian must deal with the town’s prejudice when a black child tries to attend the all-white school.
Dr. Mike’s patients begin dying mysteriously.
Brian suffers a crisis of faith when the Rev. Johnson is stricken with progressive blindness at Christmas time, despite the healing efforts of Dr. Mike.
When Sully opposes the building of a dam, he finds himself on the other side of the law and behind bars.
Dr. Mike's revered Uncle Theodore shocks her and Sully when he criticizes their parenting skills and offers to take Brian to Boston.

Alexis gives her newfound long-lost son, Adam, a job at Colbyco. Blake starts to believe that Adam may actually be his real son. Fallon and Adam keep flirting with each other, not knowing they are siblings. Adam has dinner with Krystle and Blake.
Blake tries to be friends with Adam, but Adam rejects him. Alexis tells Mark that he's still married to Krystle. Mark seeks to get a job as a tennis pro at Fallon's hotel.

Joseph's daughter, Kirby, comes to stay with the Carringtons after breaking up with her fiancé in France. Joseph tries to persuade her to go back to him. Mark gets the job at Fallon's hotel. Blake tries to get help from Congressman Neal McVane.

Fallon gets a letter from Steven, and it turns out he's on an oil rig in the Java Sea, Indonesia. Adam mixes the toxic compound in the paint for Jeff's new office. Fallon hires Kirby as a nanny for little Blake.

Jeff starts to become dizzy and is affected by the toxic paint Adam used in his office. Joseph tells Kirby to stay away from Jeff. Krystle goes to Acapulco to find out what really happened with the so-called divorce from Mark.

The Carrington family is informed that Steven's oil rig exploded. Blake goes to look for him, with an uninvited Alexis. Sammy Jo's father returns to Denver to collect Sammy Jo's share of Steven's inheritance, but Krystle throws him out.

Alexis and Blake continue the search for Steven in Indonesia, but find evidence that Steven might be dead. Blake refuses to believe it and hires a psychic, Jason Denner, to help. Jeff gets really ill from the paint in his office. Adam rapes Kirby.

Back in Denver, Blake continues his frantic search for Steven with the help of psychic Jason Dehner. Blake refuses to believe his son is dead, and Krystle is worried about his erratic behavior. Fallon mends fences with stepmother, Krystle.

An obviously ill Jeff continues to function in a confused state. Sammy Jo announces she's headed for New York to make it big as a model and no longer wants to keep her son, Danny. Blake offers the girl $100,000 to be a mother to the child.

Jeff's temper continues to grow more volatile. Adam attempts to implicate Jeff in the Cecil Colby/Logan Rhinewood scandal. After learning that Blake and Krystle intend to adopt Steven's son, Danny, Alexis demands custody of her grandson.

Although Blake begs her to postpone taking action until Jeff's violent behavior can be explained. Fallon flies to Haiti to obtain a divorce; Mark shows up unexpectedly at her hotel. Alexis tells Adam she cannot allow Jeff to be poisoned.

Alexis is concerned the doctors will learn the truth behind Jeff's illness, but Adam tries to cover by ordering his office remodeled and the lethal paint compound removed. Mark and Fallon get closer in Haiti.
Krystle suspects Alexis knows the reason for Jeff's illness; Blake tries to prevent Alexis' proposed merger; Jeff is released from the hospital, and Kirby reveals her feelings for him.
As Blake is departing for Singapore to identify his son, Alexis intercepts him at the airport to assure him she will not be stopped from merging their respective companies.
Blake persuades Steven to return to Denver for his son's sake; the rest of the Carringtons are emotional, learning that Steven's alive and returning home; once home, Steven reunites with Alexis.

Upon hearing that Kirby has married Jeff, Joseph tells his daughter she has ruined her life. Blake suggests to Alexis that they call a truce to their battle over Steven; Alexis offers Steven a share in Colbyco.

As the Board of Directors gathers to vote on the Denver-Carrington/Colbyco merger, Alexis pointedly tells the group that a nay vote will be met with immediate dismissal. The approval of the motion sends Blake into a fury.

Tasha revisits old habits when she begins to recruit soldiers for her new empire; Tariq pulls a ruse on Vincent; Proctor warns Tommy about a snitch; Ghost plans to take care of the snitch on his own terms.
The team searches for a woman who was abducted from a parking lot.

programmes.st: And the Walls Come Tumbling Down
programmes.d: Jess' visions about a skeleton lead the team to a woman's remains and the key to a 12-year-old mystery.

A 5-year-old boy goes missing while his grandmother baby-sits.
The team searches for an escaped convict.
